title: Mitosis non-stop shipping architecture (CI-to-green + blocked-MSP continuation)

completion_criteria.text: A dedicated Fable audit returns a flaw inventory of the current mitosis merge/PR-open gating with file:line citations, confirming or refuting the 7 findings from the 2026-07-27 review
Industry-standard research (merge queues, stacked PRs, CI auto-remediation, build-ahead schedulers) returns cited, verified findings
An improved architecture is specified that resolves the stop conditions and is demonstrably SIMPLER and MORE ROBUST than the current design, not merely more capable
The architecture specifies how mitosis drives a shipped MSP's CI/CD to green automatically (detect red, diagnose, fix, re-push, re-verify) with a bounded, non-looping failure path
The architecture specifies how mitosis continues into blocked MSPs while a parent PR is open for human review, without terminating the run
The user explicitly approves the architecture spec before any implementation begins

spine.active_goal: Refine the mitosis shipping architecture spec to approval, then implement. A run must never stop dead at a human review boundary: continue into blocked MSPs, drive a shipped MSP's CI to green, and resume via one idempotent command rather than a resident process. Simpler and more robust, not merely more capable.
spine.next_step: EXPLORE THE INVOKER MODEL under 0069, then edit the spec ONCE. Open: PAT vs GitHub App token (under GITHUB_TOKEN a workflow-opened child PR gets NO CI); where a replay conflict surfaces; concurrency per child MSP; cost of determinizing the advance out of the shepherd dispatch (:3006-3044). Then edit: delete 3.5, rewrite M6, fix the section 8 count (22->14/net-8 as written; net-9 after). NO implementation until the five asks in section 13 are answered. M0 separable, still unauthorized.
open_risks: Spec file on disk is STALE against 0069: section 3.5 still specifies the deleted watcher and M6 still ships it. Read the spec with 0069 in hand or the watcher reads as current.

Spec section 8's count is wrong as written (22 -> 14, net -8, not -9): the deleted watcher triad was a NEW mechanism that never got a table row. Deleting it per 0069 restores net -9. Fix table and prose together.

The Actions-workflow invoker is NOT approved. Its only new liability: one PAT or GitHub App token whose expiry fails SILENTLY until the first missed advance. It buys wall-clock CI overnight, not tokens - both invokers cost nothing while idle.

Researcher hit its context limit early. VERIFIED: GITHUB_TOKEN recursion guard, run-on-merge idiom, 60-day auto-disable of scheduled workflows. NOT verified: merge_commit_sha semantics, Actions billing, release-please/Renovate/Graphite trigger models.

Fixed cap K=8 replaces AIMD because the tuner's SIGNAL was incoherent (it re-counts a persistent APPROVED every poll cycle with no dedup, :4789-4794), not because a constant is right. Divergence frequency was never instrumented; M4 owes it.
Spec section 4 deviates from 0067 deliberately: the assertion guard is FILE-level, not line-level. Stricter, never weaker - but it is a deviation, and it is approval ask 3.

mitosis.js INLINES lib copies (window :2141-2158 = window.mjs; planReconcile :2710 = reconcile.mjs) with a drift checker at .claude/lib/superpowers-parallel/.drift-state.json. Every M3/M4/M7 deletion must land TWICE in one commit.

Live bug, unfixed: applyBuiltTransition (:473-479) never clears resumePoint; a plan-parked unit later rebuilt keeps stage:'plan', an ancestor park preserves it (:2234-2236), the :3706 guard blocks git-ref rescue, and the unit re-plans. One line.
out_of_scope: Implementation of the redesign until the user answers the five approval asks in spec section 13. NONE are answered yet.
The M0 resumePoint one-liner may be authorized on its own, but needs an explicit user go - do not land it silently under the spec gate.
Merge policy: merges to any shared branch stay human-gated. The goal is non-stop AGENT progress, never agent-performed merges. The Actions workflow may only OPEN PRs.
Autonomy beyond the mechanical advance: the CI-to-green loop needs judgment and a parked unit has no forge event, so both wait for a human. Do not extend the workflow toward autonomy.

Reopening PR-open deferral (0066). The mechanics are settled: squash-merge lands parent content under a new sha, so a published child branch must be restacked when its parent merges - a force-push on a published ref.
Unattended cron / launchd re-arm - rejected in 0069 (scheduled workflows self-disable after 60 days) and deferred as a trust-model change, not a mechanism change.
Writing analysis to .claude/reports/ - it is git-TRACKED and carries an unresolved leak caveat on the resilience thread. Keep findings in the ledger, which is not tracked.
The other mitosis threads (frontier-default, preflight-hardening, resilience-implementation) and the blocked merge-boundary/SAST thread - do not fold their work in here.
